name: Dimapur–Diphu National Highway
significance: NH 329A is a branch of NH 329. In the national highway numbering used since 2010, a letter after the number marks a spur or link off the main route — this one runs Dimapur to Diphu, and it meets NH 329 along the way.

relatedRoads.label: NH 329 — the highway this branch takes its number from, running Lumding to Manja
